To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
biodegradable elastomers were successfully synthesized using NR, cassava starch, and OMMT, and that the biodegradability was enhanced by the incorporation of OMMT.

the addition of cassava starch to natural rubber and the incorporation of organomontmorillonite (OMMT) to the NR/cassava-starch mixtures enhanced their tensile properties, biodegradabilities and water absorption.
the addition of starch and organomontmorillonite to natural rubber can improve the tensile and biodegradabilty of NR-based composites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and properties of NR/cassava-starch/OMMT biodegradable nanocomposites.
the preparation of biodegradable nanocomposites using natural rubber latex and starch, with the incorporation of OMMT as a reinforcing agent.
the preparation and characterization of NR/cassava OMMT nanocomposite elastomer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the biodegradable nanocomposites produced from NR, cassava starch, OMMT, are promising for use in disposable articles.
the addition of cassava starch and OMMT to NR latex resulted in a reduction of the tensile properties and water absorption, but enhanced biodegradability.
the incorporation of starch in the natural rubber matrix and OMMT in NR/starch composites enhanced their biodegradability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cassava starch can be incorporated in NR/OMMT nanocomposites to form biodegradable elastomers.
NR/cassava-starch/OMMT biodegradable elastomer nanocomposites were produced successfully and the properties of the elastomers could be tailored by adjusting the compositions of the components.
the incorporation of OMMT and starch in natural rubber could enhance the biodegradation of the elastomer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of cassava starch to NR/OMMT nanocomposite elastomer can improve its biodegradability.
NR/cassava biodegradable elastomer can be reinforced with OMMT to improve its properties and biodegradablility.
the incorporation of cassava starch in NR/OMMT composites can be used to produce biodegradable NR-based nanocomposite elastomer.
